business_summary: Singularity Future Technology Ltd. operates as an integrated logistics solutions provider in China and the United States. It offers transportation, warehouse, collection, last-mile delivery, drop-shipping, customs clearance, and overseas transit delivery services. The company also offers freight logistics services, including shipping, warehouse and other logistical support services. In addition, it serves the steel companies businesses. The company was formerly known as Sino-Global Shipping America, Ltd. and changed its name to Singularity Future Technology Ltd. in January 2022. Singularity Future Technology Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
business_summary_ko: Singularity Future Technology Ltd.는 중국과 미국에서 통합 물류 솔루션 제공업체로 운영되고 있습니다. 운송, 창고, 수거, 라스트마일 배송, 직송, 통관, 해외 환승 배송 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 회사는 운송, 창고 및 기타 물류 지원 서비스를 포함한 화물 물류 서비스도 제공합니다. 또한 철강 회사 비즈니스에도 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Sino-Global Shipping America, Ltd.로 알려졌으며 2022년 1월에 Singularity Future Technology Ltd.로 이름을 변경했습니다. Singularity Future Technology Ltd.는 2001년에 설립되었으며 뉴욕주 뉴욕에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
